.github/workflows/build.yml.text:
name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

concurrency:
  group: build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-web:
    name: Build Web
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build Web
        run: pnpm --filter @notion/web build
        env:
          NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: 1
          NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY }}
          CLERK_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLERK_SECRET_KEY }}
          CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN: ${{ secrets.CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_SITE_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_SITE_URL }}
          CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT: ${{ secrets.CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT }}
          EDGE_STORE_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.EDGE_STORE_ACCESS_KEY }}
          EDGE_STORE_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.EDGE_STORE_SECRET_KEY }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_QDRANT_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_QDRANT_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_QDRANT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_QDRANT_API_KEY }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL }}
          LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}

  build-ai-service:
    name: Build AI Service
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build AI Service
        run: pnpm --filter @notion/ai-service build

.github/workflows/lint-typecheck.yml.text:
name: Lint, TypeCheck & Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

concurrency:
  group: lint-typecheck-test-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: Web
            command: pnpm --filter @notion/web lint
          - target: Mobile
            command: pnpm --filter @notion/mobile lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Lint ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: ${{ matrix.command }}

  typecheck:
    name: TypeCheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: packages/ai
            command: pnpm --filter @notion/ai typecheck
          - target: packages/business
            command: pnpm --filter @notion/business typecheck
          - target: services/ai
            command: pnpm --filter @notion/ai-service typecheck
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: TypeCheck ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: ${{ matrix.command }}

  unit-test:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: Packages
            command: pnpm test
          - target: Web (AI)
            command: pnpm --filter @notion/web test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run unit tests (${{ matrix.target }})
        run: ${{ matrix.command }}

.github/workflows/ai-smoke.yml.text:
name: AI Smoke

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ai-smoke-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ai-smoke:
    name: AI Smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run AI smoke
        run: pnpm ci:ai-smoke
        env:
          AI_SMOKE_SKIP_E2E: "1"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: ai-smoke-test-results
          path: |
            test-results/
            playwright-report/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30
